svg.title: Planning: your pipeline, DoD as gates and branch protection
svg.desc: Week 14, session 2. Every Definition of Done item becomes an automated gate; branch protection makes it unavoidable; each service has its own pipeline; the work is sliced into MVP 3 stories.
svg.text: Your pipeline: DoD as gates and branch protection
Every item in the Definition of Done becomes an automated check that nobody can skip
The checklist that lets you say
reject your change if something fails.
develop / qa / main without passing gates.
Every DoD item needs a verifier that can reject it
No machine can reject it? It’s “self-certified”: a risk
Enforced by the platform, not by trust
Each service has its own pipeline with gates
Path filters: a change in /orders only runs orders CI
Contract tests across services: do they still agree?
Each service is gated independently; only green gets promoted
Each story has a testable acceptance criterion
PRs to develop require green build + tests + lint
The coverage gate fails below the floor
Secret + dependency scans block on findings
Merge to main builds and pushes a versioned image
A smoke test verifies the deployed system responds
“Deadline is tomorrow and this gate is being annoying…”
Under pressure, a test is disabled and force-merged
Fix the cause, not the gate
Gate is wrong? Fix it deliberately (reviewed), never skip it
A pipeline you bypass is theater
This is how a pipeline with protected branches feels

text.tspan: You still go through the detector
